tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i las mtha' bstan dgra 'joms pa'i spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gang zhig khro bas dgra dang ni// gnag pas bdud sde tshar gcod pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang ba byin// bya rog ming can de la 'dud// gang zhig skye bo mi bsrun pa// mthu ni bu lon ltar snyeg pa// de la mngon spyod las kyi mthu// gnam lcags 'dra ba 'di phob cig/ srung dang bzlog dang bsad pa'i mtha'// 'phang dang bsreg dang mnan pas bsdu// sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i g.yon logs su las dkyil gru gsum rdo rwa mtshon cha me ris bskor ba'i nang gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa gsum lte bar e pad 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa'i khar lcags sam rusbal chen po'i khog pa'i nang du dbang phyug chen po bsgral ba'i snying lta bu'i gtor ma rtser zhal phyung zhing bshos bu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mtshams su khram byang*/ zor kong mtshe yungs/ rtsang srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa/ rtser bzlog pa'i 'khor lo/ de'i steng du khyung gi 'khor lo/ bshos phran brgyad la dur khrod kyi zhing skyong pho mo'i 'khor lo/ steng du khyung gi 'khor lo re btsugs pa/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du sde brgyad mgon po'i gtor chen bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor ba re la rang rang gi 'khor lo dang khram byang sogs sngar bzhin brgyan/ steng du srung ba'i 'khor lo gdugs su phub/ mtha' mar rdo ra'i steng du zor rdzas rnams bshams/ gru gsum la phung shul la sogs pa gdug pa'i sa las byas pa'i brub khung re/ thod pa nag po/ mdun du bsad pa'i ling 'khor/ g.yas g.yon du thun/ g.yas su bsreg pa'i 'khor ling*/ hoṃ rdzas/ g.yon du mnan pa'i 'khor ling*/ mnan rdzas dang bcas pa bkod/ mtha' mar mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba/ gtor ma/ sha khrag rus pa don snying sogs nang khrol las byas pa phyogs bzhir bsham/ spyan gzigs mi mgo don snod kyi phreng ba mig sogs dbang po'i phra tshom can/ mtshon cha la sogs pa gshin rje'i 'dun sar yod skad pa ltar du bya'o// de nas phrin las gyer ba'i dus/

las dkyil de dur khrod kyi gzhal yas 'jigs su rung ba/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i kha lta bur bred pa'i dbus kyi lte bar gtso bo yab yum/ 'dab ma la sras mchog mgon po bzhi/ mtshams la re ti bzhi/ zla gam la nyid sprul gsum yum bcas/ rtsibs brgyad la mgon po bka' brgyad lcam dral/ rtsibs mchan la lha mo brgyad/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsibs la dur khrod kyi zhing skyong pho mo brgyad phyogs mthun gyi zhing skyong gsum ste pho nya dang bcas pa/ rtsibs mchan la sgo skyong pho mo/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsibs la sde brgyad/ phyogs mtshams la sgo skyong ba/bar bar du ye shes mgon po lcam dral las byed kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ bka' sdod kyi dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cus gtsos pa'i dkar po'i chos la srid zhur byed pa'i sde brgyad ma tshang ba med pa rnam thos sras kyi dmag tshogs lta bur mthong na skyi bung byed cing brgyal ba'i brgyal ba la thug ste khrag dron mo skyug nye ba tsam du bred pa bsgom ste mdun bskyed/ dmigs pas gnyis su sgom pa ma gtogs 'don pa gcig gis 'grub bo// de nas bsnyen pa byed dus rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying zur gsum du rno ba'i nang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje gri gug gi lte ba'i nang du sems nyid kyi ngo bo nṛ+i ming yig dang bcas pa 'od kor rdo rje'i rwa gur du yod pa zhi khro'i lha'i nus pa'i rang bzhin cis kyang mi shigs pa zhig tu gyur/ lus srid pa'i rtse nas rlung rdo rje rgya gram la thug gi bar thams cad shin tu 'jigs pa srid pa gsum khong na gnas par bsam pa'i yum gyi bha ga'i nang du brub khung bskyed chog bzhin gsal btab/ liṅga de byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis bkug nas der bcug thun rdzas kyis gzir la kha sbyar gsum phye/ lus rdul ltar du brlag rang lus me dpung gi nang du tshud pa/

rdo rje'i mkhar du gyur/ srung ba'i ting nge 'dzin no// bdag gi thugs ka dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sprul pa'i pho nya bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba nam mkha' gang bar spros/ mtshon cha sna tshogs su gyur nas byad mkhan me lce kha'i sbrang bu bzhin du gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ de'i lha srung shing lo rlung gis khyer ba lta bur bskrad nas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu song bar bsam pa'am/ shin tu 'tshub na bung ba khrag 'thung gi ting nge 'dzin bzlog sngags gsung mi chad bzla ba'o// bzlog pa'o// de nas dam can bskul nas dgra bo khug rtags ma byung bar du dgug khug nas lha dang dbye/ de nas thun 'phang zhing kha sbyar dbye bas bsad/ liṅga btub pa'i bar bsnyen dus kyi gdab las la so sor rus 'don pa tsam las khyad par med do// de ni bsad pa'o// shin tu mi bsrun na ling tshab bam la byed cing dngos su btub pa'i sha khrag gis mchod par yang gsungs so// de nas 'phang ba'i phyir ling ro de la liṅga brgya dang brgyad/ nyer gcig pa brgyad tshan/ bshos bu de dang mnyam pa zor gyi phyir bkod pa/ nyin phyed nas brtsams tshogs las byas nas nam phyed du nye ba tsam na/ slob dpon dang las mkhan chas gos nag po dug khrag gis byugs pa byas nas khri'u shing gi khar 'dug las dkyil gyi thugs gsung gi lha rnams la mchod pa byas/ liṅga re la 'bod rbad kyi sngags kyis dam can bskul/ dgra bgegs bkug nas bstim/ lha dang phye/ phur thun gyis bsad nas sha khrag rus pa thun rdzas 'bru nag la sogs pa'i bshos bu ste/ thugs gsung gi lha tshogs rnams zhal gnam sa'i bar tsam du gdangs pa/ mche ba gangs ri tsam gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug pas gsol bar bsams la shā sa na dang gsung dkyil pa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis 'bul/ bstod/ de nas sde brgyad mgon po re re'i gtso 'khor la mchod/ nyer gcig gis 'bul/ so so'i bstod pa byas nas/

chad mdo 'di ltar bsgrag go/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub snying po'i nags tshal du// ji ltar rtags gtad bsnyel lam ci// bdud sde 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig /bar du rig 'dzin bla ma'i sdes// rgya bod chos 'khor thams cad du// ji ltar rtags gtad bsnyel lam ci// gdug pa 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig /tha mar sngags 'chang bdag cag gis// sgrub cing mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor du// ji ltar rtags gtad bsnyel lam ci// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i grogs mdzod cig/ de nas pho rgyud mgon po rnams bskul ba/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung ma hā kā la'i sde// tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang ldan pa// 'khor los sgyur ba bya rog mtshan// rdo rje srin po 'jigs byed che// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dpal gyi chas kyis lus brgyan nas// 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsgral ba'i khar// rgyal po chen po'i rol pas 'gying*// khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// g.yon can 'dul bar sprul lags kyis// phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab// nag po bdud rnams tshar chod cig /hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po'i gsung*// drag shul che la stobs che ba// myur mdzad nag po phyag drug pa// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bdud dang log 'dren tshar chod cig /hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po chen po'i sku// dbang phyug che la shugs 'chang ba// gsang ba'i bdag po zhal bzhi pa// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bstan la gnod byed tshar chod cig /hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po chen po'i thugs// gtum po che la 'jigs byed pa// hūm̐ mdzad nag po phyag gnyis pa// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// gnod pa'i dgra bo tshar chod cig /hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po'i phrin las ni// gzhan gyis mi thub dpa' bo che// las mdzad nag po bya rog gdong*// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// mi mthun gnod pa tshar chod cig

/hūm̐/ las kyi mgon po chen po yi// dug gsum gdug pa'i sprul pa ni// tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag ste// rdo rje khro bo bya rog gdong*// sku las sprul pa'i khro bo che// stag zhon nag po mthu rtsal can// gsung las sprul pa'i khro bo che// tshogs bdag nag po a gho ra// thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo che// nag po chen po 'bar ba ste// yon tan sprul pa'i khro bo che// legs ldan nag po dur khrod bdag /phrin las sprul pa'i khro bo che// dpal ldan gri gug brtsegs pa che// dmod par sprul pa'i khro bo che// dpa' bo khrag 'thung nag po beng*// rbod gtong sprul pa'i khro bo che// ma ning sngags bzlog mkhan gyi gshed// dregs par sprul pa'i khro bo che// bdud mgon nag po trag shad kun// hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis thams cad dngangs// khros pa'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur blta// rngam pa'i nga ros stong gsum 'gengs// mgyogs pa'i bang gis khams gsum bskor// drag po'i stobs kyis ri rab bshig /gdug pa'i 'od kyis rgya mtsho skem// sprul pa'i dmag gis bar snang khyab// thugs dam bskul lo dam can tshogs// hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang*// zab mo'i bka' la bgrang ba dang*// dam tshig khyad du gsod pa dang*// sems can yongs la 'tshe ba dang*// rnal 'byor bar du gcod pa dang*// bdag la gnod pa'i sems can rnams// hūm̐/ rings par ded la drag tu sod// myur bar zungs la dam du chings// mgyogs par khug la nges par sod// mtshon cha rnams kyis dum bur gtubs// rngam rngam rngam rngam sha la zo// hab hab hab hab khrag la 'thung*// chem chem chem chem rus la zo// bzhes shig lhag ma med par mdzod// mo rgyud rnams la bskul ba/ hūm̐/ dbyings kyi e ka dzā ṭi ma// rnam par gtum pa'i dbang phyug mo// byed pa'i las la 'dod dbang ma// sku ni srid pa yongs kyi khyon// bha ga nam mkha'i pha mthar bsgrad// khams gsum srid pa de las 'char// nges pa'i bde klong gcig tu 'khyil// 'gag pa med pa'i 'phro 'du las// dkar mo ser mo dmar mo ljang*// ye shes ma mo re ma ti// khrag 'thung chen po rigs lnga'i yum// sku gsung thugs las grub pa'i ma// ḍā ki ra ki la ki ni// phrin las cha las tsaṇ+ḍi ka

/bar snang khams kyi glog ma sprin// dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong pa can// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// dam tshig nyams pa tshar chod cig /las mkhan ma de'i dug gsum cha// ka ki sa ki ha ki ni// de yi rnam par shes pa brgyad// mgon po brgyad kyi lcam du bstan// sgo brgyad lha mo brgyad sprul kun// khrag mtsho khol ma'i nang na gnas// skye 'gro'i srog la dbang byed ma// za byed sha za khrag 'thung ma// shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang ma// gar yang thogs med rdzu 'phrul can// pho rgyud kun gyi dbang khyer zhing*// mo rgyud kun gyi gtso mo mdzad// ngan sngags kun gyi phra men te// sngo raka gdong ma mi bsrun ma// mun pa'i nang na me ru 'bar// rlung nag 'tshub pa'i klong na rgyug /nad yams gtong zhing dal kha 'gyed// kha nas drag po hūm̐ gi 'brug /bar snang khams kun ldir byed cing*// ral pa kham nag gsig pa'i sprin// nam mkha'i dbyings rnams 'tshubs par byas// sprul pa'i pho nya'i ser ba yis// dgra bgegs thams cad brlag par byed// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad/ hūm̐/ phu nas de ni khus btab kyang*// rdo rje'i snyan gyis ma gsan nam// mda' nas de ni g.yab dor yang*// ye shes spyan gyis ma gzigs sam// ci nongs g.yel lam thugs dam can// bdag gi lus la ma bab na// sha khrag gzan du ci la 'bor// bdag gi ngag la ma bab na// gdung ba'i nga ros ci la 'bod// bdag gi sems la ma bab na// lus sems 'ben du ci la 'dzugs// las la bab bo mthu ma chung*// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// yal yol khyad gsod ma mdzad cig /btang snyoms le lo ma mdzad cig /skye bo'i ya gar ma btang cig /sems la bcangs pa ma btang cig /yid la brnag pa ma dor zhig /ming du bris pa ma btang zhig /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung*// rus pa nang khrol klad pa zo// pho rgyud rtsad nas chod la byon// mo rgyud mngal nas skem par gyis// mdza' ba kun dang myur du phrol// bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na// ma rnams dam tshig ral bar 'gyur// ming po'i dmag sna sring gis drongs// bdag gi re ba 'grub par mdzod//

de nas zhing skyong rnams bskul ba/ bh+yoḥ dur khrod chen po brgyad dang ni// nyer bzhi'i sa na gnas bcas nas// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon// 'jigs byed ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol// nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam tshig ldan pa'i stangs 'dzin no// bar snang khams nas myur du rgyug /dam nyams thams cad sdug grir gsod// sa chen 'di la rtag tu myul// skye 'gro'i srog la ham zas byed// stong gsum kun la mi thogs pas// chos mdzad sgrub po'i re ba skong*// las la rgyug cig pho nya'i tshogs// dgra srog gcod pa'i dus la bab// bar chad bzlog pa'i dus la bab// dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// de nas sgo ma rnams bskul ba/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i rgyal mo bde 'gro ma// khams gsum thams cad khyed kyis phyungs// srid pa ma mo'i gtso mo ste// za byed chen po ber nag can// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// do nub dgra la phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐/ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can// mu stegs tshogs kyi bdag dang rtse// dus bzhi'i dbang mo bzhi la sogs// rje mo bcu bzhi khyod kyi 'khor// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi phyag brnyan sha za mo// dur khrod bdag por bcas pa ni// 'jig rten las kyi ma mos bskor// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ hūm̐/ srid pa chags byed g.yu sgron ma// 'jigs pa'i mgo dgu phyag brgyad ma// rta nag dregs pa chen por bcas// gru 'degs dmag gi rgyal mo dang*// srin mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi// srid pa'i sman mo yongs kyis bskor// sprul pa'i tshogs kyis bar snang khengs// las kyi ma mo srog len ma// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab// de nas sde brgyad mgon po rnams bskul ba/

hūm̐/ gu lang chen po lha yi lha// mu stegs nag po'i ston pa che// dbang phyug shrī khrag ral can// u ma dā+e wis rtag 'khyud pa// tshangs pa 'dod lha dbang po dang*// nye dbang khyab 'jug rah+ma ṇa// gzhon nu tshogs kyi bdag po sogs// srid pa'i dbang po ma lus pa// khyod kyi bka' las gzhan mi 'da'// 'jig rten gsum na gnas gyur pa// dka' thub grub pa khyod kyi mthus// zil gyis mi gnon gang yang med// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa// da lta rnal 'byor bdag bskul gyis// phyi yi sde brgyad dmag chas nas// khams gsum srid pa thams cad la// 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyus thob// rlung gi zhags pas yid bcings nas// bdag gi dbang du 'gyur bar mdzod// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs lhung ba'i// dgra bo dmod pa drag pos gzir// lus ngag yid sum phung bar mdzod/ hūm̐/ bdud kyi mgon po seṅge'i gdong*// mdog nag lcags kyi gnya' ral can// bdud mo seṅge'i gdong mar rtse// kha nas dug nad bu yug 'tshub// phyag gnyis ru mtshon dmar gtor 'phen// khyod kyi g.yas g.yon pho nya ni// 'jigs byed dus mtshan lcam dral te// gzhan gyis mi thub dpa' bo che// rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu dang ldan// bzlog par dka' ba'i drag shul can// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i pho nya ba// skyes bu rdo rje legs pa sogs// mgar ba tho thogs ye re re// gshin rje khram thogs nyi li li// klu bdud dug 'gyed kho lo lo// bdud kyi mtshon thogs zeng nge nge*// btsan gyi bshan pa spungs se spung*// srin po'i 'o dod lhang lhang grags// srog bdag rngam shugs 'u ru ru// ma mo'i nad sprin thibs si thib// sha za 'bum sde klad du lding*// nag po stong sogs las byed pa// lha srin sde brgyad dmag gi tshogs// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// gdug pa'i dgra bo khyod la gtad// zhag dang za mar bzhag mi khom// da lta nyid du sod la shog

/hūm̐/ sa 'og rim pa dgu yi 'og /'jigs su rung ba'i mun pa'i klong*// dug gsum spyod pa 'grim pa'i 'phrang*// thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer ni// gshin rje'i rgyal khams chen po'i khab// dmyal srung gdug pa rnams kyi yul// dregs pa kun gyi bshan khang nas// 'jigs byed las kyi gshin rje ni// rab tu khros pa ma he'i gdong*// tsā muṇ+ḍi dang lhan cig rol// srid par dge sdig ci spyad pa'i// shan thang 'byed pa'i mthu bo che// khyod kyi nus pa glog ltar 'khyug /shugs ni nam mkha'i thog bas che// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs cir yang rdzu// dgra bo cham la 'bebs par 'tshal// srog bdag 'chi bdag gshed du ya// chos rgyal dgra bo'i srog la ya// ya ba ti ni tshe la ya// glang mgo can ni gzugs la ya// ral pa tshar dgu dbugs la ya// phywa sangs mdangs dang bkrag la ya// tel pa rnam par shes la ya// rmig pa dgra bo'i bla la ya// mig dmar sha rus khrag la ya// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// lo zla zhag dang za ma'i gshed// las kyi gshin rje thams cad dang*// sngags kyi lha srin sde brgyad dmag /do nub sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// dgra bo'i mdun ma rlung la bskur// bcas pa'i dmag dpung mtha' la skrod// gdug pa'i bsam sbyor kun sbyin nas// bsod nams gang 'dug bskams su chug /ci byed mtshang brlag las chol nas// mi nor sa khang phung bar gyis// dza yaḥ khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// nub nas shar du rgyu ba'i tshe// ma mo kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad// ma mo'i kiṃ kang dgra la phob// ljang sngon drag po'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// lho shar mtshams nas nub byang rgyu// dgra lha'i rgyal po'i dmag dpon mdzad// dgra lha'i kiṃ kang dgra la phob// rā hu la yi dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyungs la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// byang nas lho ru rgyu ba'i tshe// bdud po 'bum gyi dmag dpon mdzad// bdud kyi kiṃ kang dgra la phob// rog ti nag po'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// lho nub mtshams nas byang shar rgyu// srin po yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzad// srin po kiṃ kang dgra la phob// biṣ+ṭi pā ṭa'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la// shar nas nub tu rgyu ba'i tshe// dmu bdud yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzad// dmu bdud kiṃ kang dgra la phob// bi nu rā dza'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug=

nub smad mtshams nas shar lhor rgyu// gshin rje kun gyi= gshin rje'i kiṃ kang= du ba mjug ring dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la= khyab 'jug= lho nas byang du rgyu ba'i tshe// klu btsan yongs kyi= klu btsan kiṃ kang= khyab 'jug chen po'i dus la babs// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// khyab 'jug= byang shar mtshams nas lho nub rgyu// bgegs rnams kun gyi= bgegs kyi kiṃ kang= bi na ya ka'i dus la bab// mthu rtsal phyung la dgra srog chod// shar nas stag srin zor ba'i gdong*// ser nag stag mgo stag sham can// nyi ma chibs nas zor ba bsnams// shar gyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// lho nas baṃ srin dred mo'i gdong*// sngo nag dred mgo dred lpags gyon// zla ba chibs nas sbrul zhags bsnams// lho yi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// nub nas kong srin ba lang gdong*// dmar nag glang mgo glang lpags gyon// sdig pa chibs nas zangs gri bsnams// nub kyi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// byang nas 'brog srin chu srin gdong*// ljang nag chu srin g.yang gzhi gyon// rmig bu chibs nas be con bsnams// byang gi phyogs kyi dgra rnams sgrol// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// dgra bo'i srog dbugs rngam zas gyis// dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmang nas bsgyel// dgra bo'i lo tog brlag par mdzod/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed na// rgya mtsho klong yangs 'khrug pa'i nang shed na// bskal pa sbrul dang mun nag gtibs pa na// dug gsum rang gzugs 'chi bdag mgo dgu pa// bdud kyi bdud de gdug pa klu yi bdud// de dang gnyis med gdug pa'i bud med che// sbal mgo khrag gi mig dgu sbrul mjug can// dgra bo gsod la khyod las lhag pa med// sku ni dpa' brjid nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam// steng gi sa bdag thams cad kha lo sgyur// spyan gyis hur hur sa dang bar snang gzigs// gdug pa can gyi gnyan rigs thams cad khol// sku ni ri rab chen po'i ngogs la brten// nang gi lha srin sde brgyad dmag tu khol// mjug ma rgya mtsho chen po'i klong na 'khyil// gdug pa klu tshogs thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// do nub bskul lo sdang ba'i dgra steng du// pho rgyud sod la mo rgyud mngal skem shing*// chung rgyud rtsad chod 'khor 'bangs yul mi dkrugs// nor rdzas rlung bskur khang khyim 'jig tu chug

/phung byed las kyi rim pa gnyer du gtad// phung byed 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dus bzhir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod// hūm̐/ ha har rgod pa'i dur khrod chen po yi// sgrol ging tshogs pa'i grong khyer ma ru tse// rab 'jigs gnas kyi rak+ta'i rgya mtsho nas// dregs pa'i gtso bo 'jigs pa'i beg rtse can// zangs kyi ya lad rno ba'i mtshon cha bsrel// ma mo chen mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma// nam mkha'i mdog can bswe gdong me ral can// srog bdag blon po lha srin myur mgyogs dmag /mi bsrun las la glog ltar myur ba'i sde// stobs ldan drag shul can rnams dgra la bh+yo// khro ba'i shugs kyis dgra bo tshar bcad nas// dpa' ba'i byin gyis bstan pa srung ba dang*// brjid pa'i bag gis bdag gi re ba skong*// dga' ba'i nyams kyis phrin las ma lus mdzod// hūm̐/ dregs pa phyag na rdo rje'i sras// gos sngon can gyi sde dpon che// zhang 'on nag po khrag ral can// rdo rje bdud 'dul ban chen po// 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha ci yang 'dzin// rngam pa'i 'gyur ba rnam mang po'i// gnod sbyin gtum po gzi brjid can// dngul dang zangs dang bswe dang gser// rin chen bai ḍūr+ya dang shel// rdo rje'i ya lad bgos pa ni// tshogs yang che ste khams gsum khyab// rtsal che ri rab pang du 'degs// dpa' ste sus kyang mi thub pa// gtum ste srid gsum kha ru za// rtul phod de dag bzo sbyangs pa// do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rbad// gnod byed thams cad kha btags mdzod// do nub gdug pa'i bgegs la bskul// log 'dren thams cad tshar chod cig /hūm̐/ steng gi tshangs pa ging gi gtsug /bar gyi khu le lag dgu pa// 'og gi sa bdag dmu rje btsun// chos 'khor skyong ba'i pe ha ra// dgra lha'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can// sna tshogs sku lngar rdzu ba'i 'phrul// shān+ti ro zan mas dga' ba// mon bu pu tra bha dra dang*// sring mo gnod sbyin tse'u ma ra// ru 'dren gar mkhan skyo bsangs 'bag

/'gong po dam sri dmu the'u rang*// rtags chags lha ma srin thams cad// khyod kyi 'khor du bsdus nas su// chos 'khor bshig pa'i dgra la rbad// 'gong po'i phung sri kha gtod la// dbul phongs 'chos nas brlag par gyis// do nub byad ma mkhan la rbad// dam sri phug nas slongs nas su// lus ngag yid la rang gshed phob// do nub dgra bo'i steng du rbad// rgyal po'i kha gtod 'phung dkrugs la// nang 'khrug dme 'thab las la sbyor/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu skyong ba'i mgon po'i tshogs// khyod kyi 'khor tshogs mi bzad pa// 'jig rten mi la gdon du 'tshe// dam tshig can la dbal mi gzugs// rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' bas// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra la gdon// bar chad bdud kyi skyong ba chom// nag po las kyi spyod pa gtubs// hūm̐/ shar phyogs nas ni yul 'khor srung*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che// shar phyogs gnam sa phyed kyi bdag /thugs dam bskul lo ru dar phyor// 'jigs pa'i dpung tshogs dgra la khye// bdud kyis skyong ba'i mthu rtsal shig /hūm̐/ lho phyogs nas ni 'phags skyes po// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che// lho phyogs gnam sa phyed kyi bdag /thugs dam bskul lo ru dar phyor// 'jigs pa'i dpung tshogs dgra la khye// bdud kyis skyong ba'i mthu rtsal shig /hūm̐/ nub phyogs nas ni spyan mi bzang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che// nub phyogs gnam sa phyed kyi bdag /thugs dam bskul lo ru dar phyor// 'jigs pa'i dpung tshogs dgra la khye// bdud kyis skyong ba'i mthu rtsal shig /hūm̐/ byang phyogs nas ni rnam thos sras// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che// byang phyogs gnam sa phyed kyi bdag /thugs dam bskul lo ru dar phyor// 'jigs pa'i dpung tshogs dgra la khye// bdud kyis skyong ba'i mthu rtsal shig/

de nas sgo dbye ba/ hūm̐/ da ni dmar chen gtor ma gtong*// da ni thun dang zor cig 'phen// snang srid lha 'dre gnyan po kun// gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes// rnal 'byor bdag gi zor lam phyes// mtho ba lha yi zhabs bsdus shig /dma' ba lto 'phye'i mgo bskum zhig /bar gyi kiṃ kang sku bzur zhig /phyogs skyong chen po sku byol cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhig /'phrang ba rnams kyis 'phrang sol zhig /yul lha re zhig gzhan du byol// gdong du su yang ma sdod cig /do nub dmar chen gtor ma 'di// yungs sogs zor du 'grem pa 'di// sdang ba dgra yi steng du 'phen// gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du bh+yo// dgra bo'i mdun ma bshig par 'phen// legs pa'i bya ba bshol bar 'phen// nyes pa'i las la bskul bar 'phen// pho rgyud mo rgyud gcod par 'phen// yul 'khor lo tog 'joms par 'phen// mnga' 'bangs bsod nams brlag par 'phen// nag po mthu ni bu lon ltar// bsnyegs pa'i zhing bcu bsgral la 'phen// lam bstan pa/ hūm̐/ gtor chen lam bstan shar du bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs shar du khye// dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol la// rnal 'byor bdag gi dmag lam chos// yul 'dir che ge mo zhes pas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig par brtson// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad par byed// khyad par sems can yongs la 'tshe// bden pa gnyan po khyad du gsod// phan gdags lan du gnod byed pas// dam tshig gis bsdams ral bar byas// chos gzhi'i dkor brku phrogs nas za// rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas shing*// mched grogs rnams la bsdo byed pa// shi srog dmar po phod btsugs nas// khyod la mthu dang rtsal yod na// nga la ston zhes bsdo zhing smod// chos skyong srung mar brnyas byed pa// de la rnal 'byor ngas rbad do// khams gsum srid pa g.yo zhing bsgul// ri rab brdeg cing rgya mtsho 'khrug

/phyogs mtshams me yi sprin 'thibs shing*// skar mda' ltung zhing thog ser 'bebs// kun tu gnam rdo lhung ba dang*// dpa' ba'i ngar sgras khol gyur pa'i// dmag tshogs chen po der byon cig /g.yul ngo chen po der sprod cig /dgra bo thams cad kha btags nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzod cig /gtam snyan kun gyis thos par sgrogs// dpa' ba'i dar chen ngas 'bul lo// de bzhin/ gtor chen lam bstan shar lhor bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs shar lhor khye// drang srong bgrang phreng 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol la// rnal 'byor bdag gi dmag lam sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan lho ru bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs lho ru khye// gshin rje be con 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan lho nub bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs lho nub khye// srin po ral gri 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan nub tu bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs nub tu khye// chu bdag sbrul zhags 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan nub byang bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs nub byang khye// rlung lha ba dan 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan byang du bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs byang du khye// gnod sbyin dbyug tho 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur de ni spyan byol sogs/ /gtor chen lam bstan byang shar bstan// mgon po'i dmag tshogs byang shar khye// dbang ldan rtse gsum 'chang ba yang*// sku bzur sogs phyogs gar bya ba de'i 'don pa bsgyur ba'o// de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// bdud rgyal lha chen 'jigs byed du// rim par sprul nas rgyal ba'i zhing*// dug gsum las kyi rlung dmar gyis// 'jigs pa'i mun par phyogs bcug tshe// rgyal ba zhi ba'i 'od kyis sbran// khrag 'thung chen po'i sbyor mtshams nas// mgon po chen po khyod 'ongs te// drag po 'jigs byed khyo shug bsad// lha chen bka' nyan 'khor du bsdus// dga' rab dbang phyug mya ngan gyi// khang bu'i nang du bcings te bzhag

/de bzhin lnga brgya tha ma 'dir// bdud dang bdud kyi las rnams zlog /de nas lha dbang brgya byin la// lha min phrag dog dmag bsags nas// ri rab ri yi rtse mor 'thabs// de tshe lha rgyal gyis sbran pas// khyod kyis sprul pa'i dmag bkyes nas// lha min g.yul du brlag par byas// de bzhin dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// mtha' mi'i dmag lhags nang rtsod pa'i// 'khrug slong byed pa thams cad zlog /tha ma bskal pa bzang po 'dir// rtsod pa'i dus su shākya thub// byang chub snying po'i shing drung du// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// g.yon can bdud kyis g.yul bshams tshe// sems dpa' mchog des khyod sbran pas// bdud sde pham nas phyogs bcur byer// thub pa mngon par sangs rgyas gyur// de bzhin klog dang spong ba par// bar chad rtsom pa thams cad zlog /de nas rgya gar chos kyi gling*// kla klo gdug pa'i 'tshe ba byung*// khyad par mu stegs nag po rgyas// chos 'khor thams cad 'jig nye'i tshe// paṇa grub rnams kyis khyod sbran pas// kla klo thams cad thal bar btang*// mu stegs nag po chos la bsgyur// de bzhin chos min lhad zhugs pa'i// bstan la gnod pa thams cad zlog /de nas bod yul mun pa'i gling*// thub bstan nyi mas nyin byed la// nag po lha 'dres mun par bsgrubs// de tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis// khyod sbran lha 'dre bkar btags pas// chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed pa 'grub// de bzhin dge ba'i las brtsam par// gzhan gyis 'tshe ba thams cad zlog /hūm̐/ rigs kyi bdag po sku gsum gyis// ye shes lha yi bka' chad zlog /sprul pa'i khyung chen 'bar ba yis// pho rgyud mo rgyud sa bdag gi /gnod pa'i dug sbal nag po zlog /dpal ldan nag po chen po yis// bdud dang bdud phyogs gnod pa zlog /sras mchog bzhi dang yum gsum gyis// dgra bgegs gdug pa'i bsam sbyor zlog

/bka' sdod mgon po yab yum gyis// phas kyis brtsams pa'i byad kha zlog /ye shes las kyi ma mo yis// bar chad bdud kyi phyag brnyan zlog /zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro yis// dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen dang*// chad pa nad yams dal kha zlog /dbang phyug khrag ral 'khor bcas kyis// mu stegs nag po'i ngan byad zlog /bdud kyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyis// rig sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha zlog /chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis// gshin rjes gshed du dbab pa zlog /gza' bdud chen po 'khor bcas kyis// sde brgyad kiṃ kang phab pa zlog /nā ga rak+sha 'khor bcas kyis// gtad khram nag po'i gnod pa dang*// dug gi sbyor ba g.yos pa zlog /beg rtse chen po 'khor bcas kyis// lha 'dre'i shwa rdel spungs pa zlog /gnod sbyin nag po 'khor bcas kyis// dbul phongs nyams thag thams cad zlog /rgyal po ging chen 'khor bcas kyis// dam sri phung sri langs pa dang*// 'gong po'i za kha zug pa zlog /phyogs skyong rnams kyi 'khor gdon dang*// rgyal po bzhi yi bdud blon gyis// thabs sogs sbyor ba thams cad zlog /hūm̐/ srid pa'i khram kha thams cad dgra la sgyur// lha 'dre'i dmag tshogs thams cad dgra la drongs// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i las brtsams pa// byad kha phur kha rbod gtong drag po dang*// mtshe zor rbad 'dre yungs zor 'phen pa sgyur// sa bdag klu yis byad du bcug pa dang*// the'u rang 'byung pos sri rkun thams cad sgyur// gshin rje'i 'khor lo bdud kyis rkos 'debs dang*// mu stegs ngan pas bar chad byed pa sgyur// rgyal bsen rnams kyis smyo 'bogs gtong ba dang*// drang srong gza' dang klu gdon gnod pa sgyur// zhang zhung dzo zor sum pa'i glang zor dang*// bon po rnams kyis lta zor 'phen pa sgyur// ban+de'i sngags zor skye bo'i mda' zor dang*// bud med rnams kyis dmod zor 'phen pa sgyur// bdud kyi gshed langs rjed byed 'byung po dang*// ma mo rnams kyis khrag zor 'phen pa sgyur// mo rtsis ngan dang rmi lam mtshan ma ngan// ltas ngan mi rung brgyad cu rtsa gcig sgyur// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i mi nad phyugs nad dang*// gdon rigs nyi khri chig stong gnod pa sgyur// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs rnams ma lus dang*// ye 'drog chen po sum brgya drug cu dang*// gdon chen bco lnga lo zla zhag dus skeg

/mi mthun phyogs rnams dgra bgegs steng du sgyur// dus min 'chi dang 'jigs pa brgyad rnams dang*// ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra bo'i steng du sgyur// zhes bzlog sngags 'don// de nas phyir bteg la drag po'i zor/ bsnyen pa'i thun zer ba'i tshab tu zor bcug pa'i tshig dang dmigs pa rbad sngags bcas gtor chen 'phangs nas/ hoṃ gru gsum pa gdug pa can gyi shing brtsegs par 'jig rten pa'i me lha khros pa'i lto bar dam can rnams zhal gdangs par phul bar bsam zhing bsreg sngags kyis sreg mnan rgyu rnams mchod rten nam lam rgya gram du dong gru gsum pa brus par brub khung bcas bcug steng ro g.yam rdo rje rgya gram bris pas bkab/ gshin rje'i btson khang du thar dus med par steng ri rab kyis mnan par bsams nas mnan sngags bgrang*/ las kyi gshin rje la gtad pa dang bro gzhung bzhin du bya'o// de nas nang du log nas gtang rag gi mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas mnga' gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa nas// snying rjes 'jig rten la khros pa'i// rdo rje srin po khyod 'ong tshe// zhi khro rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis// yum chen rnams dang lhan cig tu// ma hā kā la thams cad kyi// 'khor los sgyur bar dbang bskur zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i byin// thams cad phul nas bdud 'dul ba'i// dpa' bo chen por mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// sems dpa' sems ma rgya mtsho yis// rnam par thar pa kun phul nas// kun tu bzang po'i rol pa yis// kun tu spyod par mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// khro bo khro mo thams cad kyis// 'jigs pa'i phyag cha kun phul nas// phrin las mdzad par mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// ma hā kā la kā li rnams// gar 'chams phyag kun phul nas// tshogs bdag chen por mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// zhing skyong ma mo mkha' 'gro'i sdes// dpal gyi chas rnams kun phul nas// legs ldan chen por mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad kyis// khas blangs rang srog kun phul nas// mgon po chen por mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// dkar po lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod phul nas// dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// rig 'dzin bla ma thams cad kyis// dam tshig gtsang ma'i rten phul nas// bstan pa bsrung bar mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo// tha mar chos byed thams cad kyis// ma traṃ bsgral ba'i baṃ phul nas// dgra gsod bshan par mnga' gsol ba// de bzhin bdag kyang mnga' gsol lo//

las rjes bsdu ba gzhung bzhin du bya'o// 'dis phas kyi byad/ dmag gi dpung*/ bsam pa ngan pa brtsams pa thams cad kho rang la bzlog par 'gyur zhing*/ bdud kyi mthu stobs nyams smad/ chos kyi mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba la som nyi med pa mang du brjod ci dgos/ nag po chen po mnyes na sangs rgyas nyid kyang tshe 'di la thabs 'di kho nas ster ro// bstan pa'i ched du nag po'i mthu sgrub cing*// rang don dkar po'i chos las mi 'da' ba'i// sngags pa de 'dra mu stegs nang 'dug kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan la gces pa'i mig 'bras yin// zong sgrub tshong rdzas nag po'i mthus byed cing*// tshe 'di'i chags sdang khong du 'tshangs gyur pa'i// sngags pa de 'dra bstan 'dzin khrod 'dug kyang*// nag po bdud kyi bang chen dang po yin// de phyir pad dkar col rgyug mi byed par// nag po'i mthu yis 'khor bar mi 'dor zhing*// dkar po'i chos kyis ngan song sgo bkag ste// bstan la ci phan kho na sgrub pa yin// dge'o/// /
